stations.title: Perpetua
stations.say: Who has gone quiet since summer?

stations.title: orders
stations.note: From the website, phone and stall.

stations.title: Win-back email
stations.text: A little money off the next order.

captions: At Mallowfield Seeds, Perpetua wants the customers who have not ordered since the summer.
One value among the autumn orders quietly empties her whole list.
You show what empties it, then fix the list and the catalogue print run.
Now the list holds everyone who has gone quiet, and the email goes out.
Same customers, same orders. An unknown means what Perpetua says it means.
